sample.m4a and sample.ogg are copied unmodified from github.com/dhowden/tag's
own test fixtures (testdata/without_tags/); sample.dsf from the same
project's testdata/with_tags/ (it has no without_tags DSF fixture, and the
existing tags are useful for testing that writing one field leaves the
others alone). dhowden/tag is already a direct dependency of this project —
these are real, minimal, valid containers of the exact formats
writeTagLib needs to round-trip against, which would otherwise be
impractical to hand-build byte-for-byte the way the FLAC/MP3 fixtures
elsewhere in this package are.
